name: Compliant Naira
oneLiner: cNGN is a centralized Nigerian naira stablecoin backed 1:1 by NGN deposits at designated Nigerian commercial banks under the cNGN issuer consortium.
collateral: Naira reserves held 1:1 against outstanding cNGN, comprising deposits at licensed Nigerian commercial banks plus naira money-market funds and short-term FGN treasury bills, verified by monthly independent attestations
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption path designed to maintain 1 cNGN = 1 NGN through naira reserves and compliant transfer rails

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: CNGN issuer and transparency materials describe naira bank deposits, money-market funds, and short-term Nigerian government bills, but the reviewed sources do not provide the current assurance, reconciliation, claim segregation, custody continuity, or loss-recovery inputs required for a complete mechanism review.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: cNGN is issued by the Africa Stablecoin Consortium. On EVM chains the token owners are Gnosis Safe 2/2 multisigs of the same two consortium signers (re-verified on all four chains 2026-07-20; Polygon Safe 0xce6720dd9076aa67053abb27ecbd613a5867d1ba enumerated for the first time). The Base contract additionally has an EOA-owned ProxyAdmin enabling upgrades. On Solana the Token-2022 mint authority is a PDA of the issuer's issuance program 9GrUiE6YkLTTt7koEQfeyqNgEpoSyvkBmPjfrZd3AS28 (operational authority EOA 88ifu36R...; program upgradeable by EOA 8Ng3h97W...), with freeze/delegate held by an SPL 2-of-2 multisig.

controls.label: Africa Stablecoin Consortium issuance backend (multi-party authorized)
controls.evidence: Mint requests require treasury verification of the naira deposit plus approval by authorized consortium staff before tokens are created; burn occurs on redemption. Supply is fully issuer/consortium-controlled.

At finalized Solana slot 434276320, issuance program 9GrUiE6YkLTTt7koEQfeyqNgEpoSyvkBmPjfrZd3AS28 resolved to ProgramData BqJQj1J5a89WxEPf5TM8ppV5fbCKZFMGVGJNefB9Copb with upgrade authority EOA 8Ng3h97WUFx1QoQFadVTUTC2YKDdr4h1xGNETqsqvYZx. Both paths can change mint-critical logic without a contract-enforced delay.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cNGN is issued natively by the Africa Stablecoin Consortium on each of its five chains; no bridge protocol holds mint rights on any deployment. 2026-07-20 dc-8 pass re-verified every chain on-chain: all four EVM tokens are owned by Gnosis Safe 2/2 multisigs of the same consortium signer pair (Polygon owner 0xce6720dd... enumerated for the first time), and the Solana Token-2022 mint is gated by the issuer's issuance program with a 2/2 SPL multisig on freeze/delegate. The earlier Across note described an optional third-party liquidity path, not the issuance route.
